Name: Nanami Kento NPC High Res Portrait
Author: PanZishan
Description:
This mod is simply meant to replace the original portraits of OurpleKay's mod to a higher resolution one drawn by me.

It does not add Nanami as a character or change anything else in the original mod. The mod works on its own without any other portrait mods if you only want Nanami's portraits to be a higher resolution, but I highly recommend using any high res portrait mod of your choice! I personally made this to match DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod.

Requirments:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Valley Modding API
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23552]Nanami Custom NPC (Jujutsu Kaisen)
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] (Adds higher resolution portraits and easily switch between different Portrait Mods)


How to install:
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher (follow the download instructions in respective mods description)
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23552]OurpleKay's mod[/url] and unzip into your Mods folder in your files.
3. Download Portraiture and unzip into your Mods folder in your files.
4. Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder in your files.
5. Place the png image into StardewValley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[whatever other portrait mod u wanna use]
6. Run the game using SMAPI and press p in the in-game dialogue to switch the portraits.

Since I use DCBurger's high res portraits for all other villagers I put the Nanami.png into the same folder as DCBurger's png images. If you use another high res mod you will put the Nanami.png into that folder instead.

So for me, the Nanami.png is placed into: StardewValley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\DCBurger
The name of the folder doesn't actually matter, the important thing is that all portraits you want to use are in the same folder INSIDE the folder named "Portraits"

Since OurpleKay was also kind enough to make it possible to choose if Nanami's in-game name is Nanami or Kento I've also made two diffierent files that work with respective file. The only difference between these png is that they're either named Nanami.png or Kento.png

This is my first time making a mod so please lmk if there's something missing or not working :)[b]
[/b]
